messages:
anya: Heads up — bringing up q-llama-int4 on staging for inference. Latency/cost look great but we see subtle quality drift on one of our promptsets (dialogue summarization + code examples). Can curation/labeling ops run a micro-golden + de-dupe pass and triage?
micah: Which promptset exactly? the "long-dialogue-summ" or the mixed code+conv one? and what metric/regression size are we seeing? :eyes:
lena: long-dialogue-summ primarily. Canary run vs baseline (orig-llama-4b) showed ~3.2% drop in ROUGE-L on the micro-canary (n=500), plus a handful of tokenization misalignments for code blocks.
eval-bot: ran canary at 2025-07-14 14:12 UTC
```
baseline: ROUGE-L 0.412
q-llama-int4: ROUGE-L 0.399
delta: -0.013 (~3.2%)
notable: 12/500 code blocks truncated at 512 -> token boundary
```
sam: ok — I'll kick off a dedupe + micro-golden extraction. running sampler now:  
```
./sampler extract --set long-dialogue-summ --size 800 --filter dedupe_v3 --seed 2025
```
sam: will push a 200-item micro-golden of edgecases (long context + inline code) to review queue when done. ETA ~45m.
eva: can we prioritize examples that used function-calling outputs and multi-turn edits? those are where hallucination spikes. also, request labelers to add a "reason" tag when they mark a regression (format: "regression_type: hallucination|truncation|formatting").
shane: labeler capacity tomorrow morning limited — can you add a quick priority flag so ops picks top 100? otherwise it becomes a backlog.
anya: yes — mark priority=critical for anything that drops ROUGE-L by >2% or shows truncated code. micah @sam please attach the eval diffs to the queue items.
labeler-bot: created queue "golden-review-qllama-int4-20250714" with 200 items; priority=critical for 120 items; ETA labels assigned to team-curation@ (12 folks). link: https://tasks.redwood/goldens/1789995555
lena: quick note — dedupe_v3 removed ~18% overlap vs previous runs, but we lost some rare paraphrase variants. i'll add a small holdout of 50 paraphrases to the micro-golden to check recall.
micah: thanks. after labeler pass, can we run the regression harness and a small A/B on customersim env? if it persists we'll need quant-kernel rollback or a mixed-precision fallback.
eva: if labelers mark many "formatting" regressions, that could point to tokenizer/serialization with int4 kernels — flagging infra to trace. ops: @shane can you enable trace logs for tokenizer path for the next canary run?
shane: will enable + add an observability tag. scheduled next canary @ 2025-07-15 02:00 UTC.
anya: perfect — thanks everyone. please drop short notes here when micro-golden is up and when the first 50 labels are in. :thumbsup:
